title: The Residual - a small free 2D narrative mystery platformer - out on steam
author: SevielGD
selftext:
I just released **The Residual**, a short 2D narrative platformer on Steam.

It's a deliberately small game, around **20–30 minutes long,** about loneliness, memory, love, and a strange broken world.

Generative AI was part of the development process:

* AI assisted me with programming, especially repetitive/boring tasks, although I wrote and controlled the codebase myself.
* Most of the game's visual assets were generated with AI and then selected, edited and integrated into the game.
* The player character was created without generative AI.
* Game design, writing, level design, implementation and the overall direction were done by me.

Main thing that was preventing me from returning to gamedev (I did some stuff on flash and later android 2010 - 2018) was that I didn't have anybody to do art. Now with AI I was able to generate majority of stuff.

The game is completely free if anyone wants to try it:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5291650/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5291650/)

Would like to know if anyone finds it fun (or stupid/boring :D).
